cause_quote: The new rollback snapshot called `.update(fs.readFileSync(path.join(packageDir, "package.json")))` for existing plugin directories, causing a missing manifest to abort the package swap with `ENOENT`.
user_saw: The core update failed and rolled back whenever a managed npm plugin still had an install directory but was missing its package.json.
summary: The fix records a null manifest digest for damaged prior plugin installs while still requiring manifests for staged and published plugins.
reasoning: PR #133884 had already made core updates tolerate an unavailable replacement for a damaged plugin, and I checked that the parent of #188978 still had an end-to-end scenario that removed package.json and verified the new core version was installed. PR #188978 added the mandatory pre-swap snapshot that rethrew ENOENT for an existing directory, and the fix bundle reports that the same scenario failed at that read.
